# Policy Translator Copilot instructions

Read and follow [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before changing this repository.

Preserve deterministic generation, dependency ordering, idempotency, least privilege,
simulation-first behavior, PowerShell/live-Graph parity, and honest gap reporting.
Trace feature changes across every surface listed in `AGENTS.md`, use current official
Microsoft documentation as evidence, and never use real customer or tenant data.
